items.q: Nat Tōles' band would have made it.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. So John just went out there. But if John would have heard our band, Gary, we would have made it. Nat Tōles' band would have made it. That's just -- the wrong thing, and you --
Had you told Hammond about the Nat Tōles -- when you drove up there?
